## Wave 8 Summary

Wave 8 discharges the seven S93 carry-forwards from the S92 LQG × phonon-first workshop (`session-92-lqg-phonon-first-workshop.md`, CONVERGED 2026-05-23) that reduced the §IX.7 narrow path — the only structurally-coherent route by which canonical LQG kinematical observables (area operator, spin networks, Wilson lines) could enter the framework as DERIVED emergent shadows of the substrate `(A_K, H_K, D_K)` — to **a single empirical question** about one dimensionless bridge coefficient `α_bridge`. The chain: `α_bridge ≈ 4.81×10⁻³` from substrate physics ⇒ narrow path closes (Regime I, `γ_emergent = γ_BH = 0.2375`); `α_bridge ∼ O(1)` ⇒ narrow path FAILS structurally (Regime II, `γ_emergent ∼ 50`, ~200× too large), with NO recovery mechanism because γ does NOT admit cutoff running (Paper 03 §VII; LQG-theorist Q2). The substrate-side prior (N_e=2.92 post-fold acoustic e-folds, the only landed bulk-to-surface reduction magnitude) favors Regime II structural failure (≥0.6 mass) over Regime I (≤0.3).

The wave is **EVOI-priority-ordered** per the workshop's re-ordered Wave 1 sequence (C3 acceptance). W8-1/W8-2 are tiny cache-load pre-flights (<0.05 we each) that feed the highest-EVOI joint test **W8-3** (<0.1 we), which tests whether the required `α_bridge` is consistent with BOTH the substrate-side Cauchy-Schwarz moment floor AND the LQG-side area-volume uncertainty band at canonical j≤3 spin-networks. W8-4 verifies/completes the canonical-constants pins (most already on disk from the S92 workshop). W8-5 writes the §VI Workshop-1 gate-prereg as an R3 YAML block (METHODOLOGY-class plan-authorship). W8-6 predicts the structural pre/post-fold ratio `α_bridge^pre/α_bridge^post` from the S38-PROVEN substrate Bogoliubov coefficients. W8-7 dispatches Workshop 6 (Substrate Mode Localization on Emergent 3-Slices), **gated on W8-3**: PASS → workshop targets canonical LQG matching; FAIL → workshop targets the substrate's OWN narrow-path effective theory.

**Substrate-first direction of explanation (preserved in every gate)**: the substrate `√(C_2(p,q))` is PRIMARY (intrinsic to the D_K spectrum on Jensen-deformed SU(3)); the LQG `√(j(j+1))` SU(2) area-spectrum eigenvalue is the candidate EMERGENT shadow. Per `phononic-framing.md §"IS Space, Not IN Space"`, the bridge map flows substrate → HKR/Cheeger-Simons → laboratory-IN LQG kinematical observable. Inverting this (treating the LQG area operator as fundamental and the substrate as a discretization of it) is a container-thinking violation.

**Plan-freeze count-convention finding (load-bearing — encoded into W8-1)**: the LQG-spec phrase "all 155,984 D_K eigenvalues" refers to the documented `a_0 = card(spectrum at L_max=10)` figure (s75 `f_conv` output; baseline-findings-s66; `N_DK_eigenvalues = 155984`). W8-1 therefore pre-registers its PASS criterion as the **cache's own internal-integrity cross-check** (`Σ_sector len(abs_evals)` reproduced bit-for-bit AND per-sector `len(abs_evals) = 16·dim(p,q)`), with "155,984" recorded as a documented cross-convention annotation citing the s75/s86 provenance — NOT as a literal equality gate. A literal `Σ = 155984` gate against the current cache would be a degenerate/false-FAIL test (Class-8.3 publication-precision boundary; count-convention mismatch, not substrate-physics). The eigenvalue inventory is reported at BOTH `L_max=10` (the historical narrow-path comparison scope) AND `L_max=12` (the cache's native ceiling, `L_max_operational`).

    Consume the W8-1 inventory npz. For every populated (p,q) sector compute
    C_2(p,q) two ways: (i) the helper _spectral_action_regulators.casimir_su3(p,q)
    = (p²+pq+q²+3(p+q))/3; (ii) the explicit LQG-spec closed form
    (p²+pq+q²)/3 + (p+q). Cross-check both against a Sage-MCP sage_eval of the
    symbolic form. Build the joint table: per sector, columns = (p, q,
    dim(p,q), level=p+q, multiplicity, min|λ|, C_2(p,q), √(C_2(p,q))). The
    substrate-side area-spectrum candidate is √(C_2(p,q)); the join with min|λ|
    is the (eigenvalue, Casimir) pairing the narrow path's Step-5 area-matching

    DIAGNOSTIC (Friedrich-Bär scaling λ_min ≈ η_FB·√(C_2+1)/r(τ)), NOT a gate.
  producing_script: "computations/session-93/s93_w8_2_narrow_path_casimir_table.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) — ALL required, ALL non-empty ----

# (1) operator — the mathematical comparison form
operator:
  type: "equality"
  form: "|casimir_su3(p,q) − ((p²+pq+q²)/3 + (p+q))| == 0 (bit-precision) for ALL populated (p,q); AND |helper − Sage_closed_form| < 1e-12 for ALL (p,q); AND joint-table sector coverage == W8-1 sector count"

  proof_ref: "_spectral_action_regulators.py:43-45 casimir_su3 = (p*p+p*q+q*q+3*(p+q))/3.0; algebraically identical to LQG-spec (p²+pq+q²)/3+(p+q); Sage-MCP sage_eval confirms the symbolic identity exactly"

  mesh_density: "discrete — C_2(p,q) is a rational (in fact (integer)/3) on the integer (p,q) lattice; the equality C_2_helper==C_2_LQGspec is exact on every mesh point"

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter of producing_script, pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "90 sectors (L_max=12); each evaluated 3 ways (helper, LQG-spec closed form, Sage-MCP)"
  L_max: "12 (matches W8-1 inventory scope; L_max=10 sub-table inherited)"

# (6) audit_discriminators — which inputs feed audit_sha256 vs content_sha256
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap", "w8_1_inventory", "spectral_action_regulators"]

# (7) substitution_chain — mandatory for sign/direction/threshold claims

## §W8-6. S93-W8-6-NARROW-PATH-PRE-POST-BOGOLIUBOV-RATIO

```yaml
# ---- Identity (4 fields) ----
gate_id: "S93-W8-6-NARROW-PATH-PRE-POST-BOGOLIUBOV-RATIO"
schema_version: "R3"

classification: "PHONONIC"
agent_type: "phonon-first-cosmologist"
hypothesis: "The substrate-side Bogoliubov transformation U_B (S38 PROVEN, P_exc=1.000, 59.8 GGE pairs) descends to a Bogoliubov-covariant map Π̂_S^pre → Π̂_S^post on the kinematical Hilbert space H_K, so the structural ratio α_bridge^pre/α_bridge^post is a fixed substrate-derived identity (set by the |u_k|²,|v_k|² Bogoliubov coefficients), pinnable BEFORE the Step-4 projection operator is constructed; FAIL iff U_B is not a covariant projection-conjugation (i.e., Π̂_S does not transform covariantly under U_B)."

method:
  description: >
    Derive the structural ratio α_bridge^pre/α_bridge^post from the S38 PROVEN
    GGE Bogoliubov coefficients. At the kinematical-H_K layer (per the
    workshop's R2 C4 reading of S74), Π̂_S^pre and Π̂_S^post live on the SAME
    Hilbert space related by U_B: Π̂_S^post = U_B Π̂_S^pre U_B†. The bridge
    coefficient α_bridge is a trace functional of the projection's image of the
    surface 2-form; under U_B it transforms by the Bogoliubov weight. Compute
    the ratio from the S38 |u_k|², |v_k|² coefficients (P_exc=1.000, 59.8 GGE
    pairs): the ratio is the Bogoliubov-weighted moment ratio, a pure substrate
    number INDEPENDENT of the (yet-unbuilt) explicit Π̂_S. Verify U_B is a
    Bogoliubov-covariant conjugation (the [SIGN]-trigger directional claim: the
    ratio is >1 or <1 set by whether the post-fold GGE squeezing amplifies or
    suppresses the surface coefficient — derive the sign from the substitution
    chain). Pin the ratio as a structural identity (Class-(b) forward-extension
    per the cross-pillar bridge anatomy).
  producing_script: "computations/session-93/s93_w8_6_narrow_path_pre_post_bogoliubov_ratio.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) — ALL required, ALL non-empty ----

# (1) operator — the mathematical comparison form
operator:
  type: "ratio"
  form: "α_bridge^pre/α_bridge^post = R_BG (a fixed substrate number from the U_B |u_k|²,|v_k|² coefficients); covariance check: ||Π̂_S^post − U_B Π̂_S^pre U_B†|| == 0 (Bogoliubov-covariance of the projection-conjugation)"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary — exact threshold value + direction
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "covariance residual == 0 (exact, by construction if U_B is a covariant conjugation); R_BG pinned as the Bogoliubov-weighted moment ratio with its sign (R_BG>1 or R_BG<1) derived from the substitution chain"
  direction: "="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically — is the threshold analytically derived?
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "S38 PROVEN GGE Bogoliubov U_B (P_exc=1.000, 59.8 pairs); SU(1,1) squeeze-identity (BCS squeeze IV + cosmological Bogoliubov I, MEMORY.md cross-pillar bridge); Π̂_S^post = U_B Π̂_S^pre U_B† covariance is exact for a unitary Bogoliubov conjugation"

# (4) reachable_rationals — does the admissible region contain a rational mesh?
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous (R_BG is a Bogoliubov-weighted moment ratio of |u_k|²,|v_k|² over the 59.8-pair GGE spectrum; the covariance residual is an exact 0 by unitarity, not a mesh)"

# (5) machinery_pin_map — every free parameter of producing_script, pinned
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "59.8 GGE pair modes (S38 Bogoliubov spectrum); 1 ratio + 1 covariance residual"
  L_max: "N/A (kinematical-H_K Bogoliubov layer; the S38 GGE spectrum is the relevant mode set, not the L_max truncation)"
  scan_range: "the S38 GGE pair-mode index set (59.8 effective pairs)"
  step_size: "N/A — per-mode Bogoliubov coefficients"
  tolerance: "covariance residual exact 0 (unitary conjugation); R_BG full-float64 pinned; sign derived analytically (no tolerance on the half-line)"
  scheme: "narrow-path-pre-post-bogoliubov-ratio-SU11-squeeze-covariant-projection"
  convention: "NARROW-PATH-pre-post-bogoliubov-ratio-S38-PROVEN-U_B-P_exc-1p000-59p8-pairs-kinematical-H_K-layer"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg (small Bogoliubov coefficient arrays over 59.8 modes; no large matrices)"

# (6) audit_discriminators — which inputs feed audit_sha256 vs content_sha256
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap", "s38_bogoliubov_coeffs"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — mandatory for sign/direction/threshold claims
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "α_bridge^pre/α_bridge^post = R_BG is a fixed substrate ratio, and
            its sign (>1 or <1) is set by the post-fold GGE squeezing."

    Step 1 [Definition]: U_B = Bogoliubov transform with coefficients u_k, v_k,
            |u_k|²−|v_k|²=1, P_exc=Σ|v_k|²/Σ(...) =1.000 over 59.8 GGE pairs.
            [canonical: S38 PROVEN; MEMORY.md SU(1,1) bridge]
    Step 2 [Definition]: α_bridge ∝ Tr(Π̂_S · Ŝ_surface) where Ŝ_surface is the
            exit-horizon 2-form operator; at the kinematical layer Π̂_S^post =
            U_B Π̂_S^pre U_B†. [canonical: workshop R2 C4 kinematical reading]
    Step 3 [Substitution]: α_bridge^post = Tr(U_B Π̂_S^pre U_B† · Ŝ) =
            Tr(Π̂_S^pre · U_B† Ŝ U_B) ⇒ ratio = Tr(Π̂_S^pre Ŝ)/Tr(Π̂_S^pre Ŝ_BG),
            Ŝ_BG = U_B† Ŝ U_B the Bogoliubov-rotated surface form.
    Step 4 [Simplify]: the ratio reduces to the Bogoliubov-weight moment ratio
            R_BG = ⟨Ŝ⟩_pre / ⟨U_B† Ŝ U_B⟩_pre, a number fixed by {|u_k|²,|v_k|²}
            ALONE — independent of the explicit Π̂_S form (it cancels in the
            ratio modulo the Bogoliubov rotation).
    Step 5 [Direction]: post-fold GGE squeezing (|v_k|²>0, particle-pair
            creation) AMPLIFIES the surface-form expectation if the squeezing
            aligns with Ŝ ⇒ ⟨U_B†ŜU_B⟩ > ⟨Ŝ⟩ ⇒ R_BG < 1 (the post-fold bridge
            coefficient is LARGER than the pre-fold). The sign is derived, not
            assumed; the producing script confirms it from the S38 coefficients.
    Conclusion: PASS iff U_B is a Bogoliubov-covariant conjugation (residual 0)
            AND R_BG pins as a fixed substrate ratio with the derived sign;
            FAIL iff Π̂_S does not transform covariantly (U_B not a unitary
            projection-conjugation at the kinematical layer).

# (8) input_files — every file the producing_script reads, with SHA pin
input_files:
  canonical_constants:
    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "1aa90bb157dbb615eec808fa2a8a211b87e656c2a3ae32f03358d7911190790c"
  s38_bogoliubov_coeffs:

  wp_section:
    path: "sessions/archive/session-93/session-93-w8-workingpaper.md"
    artifact_kind: "wp_section"
    section_anchor: "### §W8-6. S93-W8-6-NARROW-PATH-PRE-POST-BOGOLIUBOV-RATIO"
    must_contain:

      - "\\*\\*MCP Pre-Compute Audit\\*\\*"

# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: "The substrate Bogoliubov U_B descends to a covariant projection-conjugation at the kinematical layer, and α_bridge^pre/α_bridge^post = R_BG is a fixed substrate identity pinnable before Π̂_S is built. This gives Workshop 6 (W8-7) a substrate-derived relative constraint between pre- and post-fold bridge coefficients, narrowing the construction even if the absolute α_bridge magnitude awaits the explicit projection operator. Pinned as a Class-(b) cross-pillar forward-extension."

The workshop's R2 C4 kinematical reading of S74 (Π̂_S^pre, Π̂_S^post on the same H_K) is then obstructed; the pre/post relation requires the full emergent-metric-layer S74 treatment (where the two manifolds genuinely do not embed)."

## Wave 8 → Downstream Decision Point

**Intra-wave dispatch topology**: `{W8-1 → W8-2 → W8-3}` is the pre-flight chain (W8-2 consumes W8-1's inventory npz; W8-3 consumes W8-1's inventory). W8-4 is independent (canonical-pin audit) and may run in parallel with W8-1. W8-5 consumes the L2 chain + W8-3's discriminator structure (author the Workshop-1 block once W8-3's PART-A/PART-C structure is fixed; the block itself is plan-frozen here, so W8-5 can run in parallel after W8-3). W8-6 is independent of W8-3 for the ratio derivation (reads S38 coefficients) but reads W8-3's verdict for narrative framing. **W8-7 is GATED ON W8-3** (and consumes W8-6).

| W8-3 verdict | W8-7 target | W8-5 Workshop-1 regime | Downstream (S94) |
|:-------------|:------------|:-----------------------|:-----------------|
| **PASS** (Regime I survives) | canonical LQG matching: does the Reading-(b) cocycle give α_bridge≈4.81e-3? | Regime I → PASS pre-reg | If W8-7 CONVERGES → §VII.W-style bridge entry (narrow path constructively closes); if not → Reading (d) revisit |
| **FAIL** (Regime I pre-forbidden) | substrate's OWN narrow-path effective theory: what α_bridge / γ_emergent does the cocycle give? | Regime II → FAIL pre-reg | W8-7 characterizes the substrate's own kinematical-layer effective geometry (the framework OWNS it; does not borrow from LQG) |
| **INFO** (j-band ambiguous) | determine area-volume band edges first, THEN re-key W8-7 | Regime III → INFO (deferred-pending) | refined area-volume band computation (S94 carry-forward) before W8-7 dispatches |
| **unmet at W8-7 dispatch** | — | — | W8-7 honest mechanical closure (`PRE-REG-INC_blocked_by_S93-W8-3_unmet`), deferred to S94 |

**Substrate-side prior reminder (NOT a gate, a prior)**: the N_e=2.92 bulk-to-surface reduction anchor places ≥0.6 prior mass on Regime II (W8-3 FAIL). A W8-3 PASS would be a structurally surprising result; the EVOI of W8-3 is high precisely because it discriminates the Regime-I/Regime-II corridor at <0.1 we BEFORE any Step-4 machinery is built.

**After W8-1**: PASS → W8-2/W8-3 proceed; FAIL → cache integrity broken, halt the pre-flight chain, route cache re-derivation to S94 (W8-4/W8-6 independent and still run).

**After W8-3 (the pivotal decision)**: PASS → W8-7 targets canonical LQG matching, W8-5 Workshop-1 pre-reg is Regime-I-PASS; FAIL → W8-7 targets the substrate's own effective theory, W8-5 is Regime-II-FAIL; INFO → determine area-volume band first, W8-5 is Regime-III-INFO, W8-7 re-keys after band determination.

**After W8-6**: PASS → R_BG pinned as a substrate forward-extension feeding W8-7's relative constraint; FAIL → kinematical-layer Π̂_S covariance obstructed, W8-7's pre/post relation defers to the full emergent-metric-layer S74 treatment.
